TENDERD is a fleet and equipment management platform that provides real-time tracking, telematics, utilization monitoring, maintenance insights, and emissions visibility across heavy industries. It helps construction, logistics, mining, energy, and oil and gas companies reduce operational costs, improve safety, and increase asset productivity through a single unified platform.

TENDERD offers GPS tracking, mixed-fleet telematics, equipment utilization analytics, preventive maintenance planning, fuel monitoring, emissions tracking, safety insights, and centralized dashboards. The platform connects vehicles and heavy equipment into one system, giving operations teams full visibility across sites, yards, and distributed projects.

TENDERD helps reduce fuel waste, minimize unplanned downtime, improve asset utilization, and strengthen compliance reporting. Operations teams gain real-time visibility, automated insights, and actionable analytics that support faster decision-making. The result is lower OPEX, longer equipment lifespan, and improved project execution.

A fleet management system brings vehicle and equipment data into one platform to help businesses track assets, manage maintenance, monitor fuel consumption, improve safety and optimize fleet operations.

Fleet and equipment tracking is the use of GPS and telematics technology to monitor vehicle and asset location, usage, fuel consumption, and operational performance in real time. It enables companies to improve visibility, prevent misuse, reduce downtime, and optimize how assets are deployed across sites and routes.

Fleet and equipment tracking improves asset utilization, reduces idle time, lowers fuel costs, prevents theft, and enables predictive maintenance. For heavy industries such as construction and mining, it also enhances site safety, ensures regulatory compliance, and supports data-driven planning across multiple projects.

Fleet telematics collects and transmits data from vehicles and equipment to provide visibility into performance, location, engine health, and operator behavior. The purpose is to transform raw operational data into actionable insights that improve efficiency, reduce risk, and extend asset lifespan.
How can TENDERD help improve fleet productivity and reduce operational costs?

TENDERD improves fleet productivity by identifying underutilized assets, reducing idle time, automating maintenance alerts, optimizing fuel usage, and providing centralized operational dashboards. By turning real-time equipment data into actionable insights, TENDERD helps operations leaders increase uptime, lower OPEX, and make faster, evidence-based decisions across their fleet.
